settings.title: Who can register for a wholesale account?
settings.text: Wholesale accounts are available to verified businesses including retailers, boutiques, spas, online stores, interior designers, and gift shops. A valid ABN and resale details is required.

settings.title: What is the minimum order value?
settings.text: Our minimum wholesale order value is AUD $350 (ex GST and freight). This threshold remains fixed, even when promotional offers or discounts are applied.

settings.title: How do I apply for a wholesale account?
settings.text: Simply register for wholesale access via our login/register page. Once approved, you’ll receive access to wholesale pricing and ordering. Should you have any trouble registering please contact us on sales@pastelpines.com

settings.title: Where are your products manufactured?
settings.text: All Pastel Pines home fragrance products are manufactured in our factory located in South Windsor, NSW, Australia.

settings.title: Do you offer private-label or custom branding?
settings.text: Yes. We specialise in private-label manufacturing for candles, diffusers, room sprays, essential oils, pot pourri and more. Minimum order quantities apply. Please refer to the Private Labelling page on our website for more information.

settings.title: How long will it take to dispatch my order?
settings.text: Our typical lead time is approximately 5-7 working days, depending on product type and order size.

settings.title: Do you supply internationally?
settings.text: Yes. We welcome international wholesale enquiries. Please contact our sales team with your region and requirements.

settings.title: What support do you offer wholesale partners?
settings.text: We provide catalogues, product images, scent descriptions, pricing support, and merchandising guidance to help you present our products to your customers.

settings.title: Need more help?
settings.text:
Our team is here to assist with wholesale enquiries, product details or private-label information.
